title: Armour
basis: R = as printed in the book. Fields marked uncertain / judged / *Note carry the reader's doubts; printed totals are kept even where parts do not add up.
notes: Book pages 100-130 = PDF pages 1-31 of 'Sec 1 - Armr.pdf' (PDF page = printed page - 99).

Re-checked against the book on 15 Nov 2026: every page looked at as an image. The org charts of this section print no personnel figure in any box (figures are only in the 'Summary of Pers and Vehs' tables), so no chartStrength is set.

vehicles lists hold the summary-table categories first (Whs = wheeled, Trs = tracked, 'Total less Tlrs', Tlrs; marked summary: true), then the types printed in the chart or the table notes. Types are part of the categories: do not add both.

Radio sets (equipment items with kind: 'radio') are counted from the radio comm diagrams (pp 111-112): sets drawn per station, one tk / recce sqn drawn and A, B, C Sqns taken as the same. The book adds: VRC 889 instead of VRC 80/81 A in tks; VRC 4622 instead of VRC 79 in jeeps.
exclPers = personnel the printed total leaves out (SWs, NCs(U)/civs); attPers = attached personnel listed in the notes; warIncrement = war-increment personnel / transport printed under the table.
Section-wide tables (ammo scales, planning data, T-80 UD / Al-Zarrar planning parameters and 1st / 2nd line tpt, inf/tk coop radio links, CCO layout) are in armrData.

armrData.title: Comparative Data Current Main Battle Tks
armrData.note: Characteristics of the 12 tanks are on their weapons.json entries (section 'Sec 1 - Armr'); re-checked figure by figure on 15 Nov 2026, no differences found.
notes: 1. Pakistan Army is eff using Mole Plough to create the M fd gap with utmost speed. The device is being locally mfr in Pakistan and is fitted in front of the tk like a plough blade, which digs out the mines in front of it. It is simpler and cheaper than the roller type devices. Inf Safe Lanes (ISLs) are made by clearing M fd about 80-100 Ms in about 15 mins. Each tk can provide two ISLs.
2. APFSDS (DU) is one of the latest anti tk ammo with enhanced pen power. It has uranium coating on the tip, which provides addl str and ability to withstand more temp.
